short: The work: the workflow domain crate
is: The workflow domain crate: the commission aggregate and an account's boards, with the ports that store them; I/O-free, built on kernel and identity only (shared allowed).
conventions: Depends on kernel and identity only (shared allowed), never on the domain façade, an adapter or a driver; doc links up a layer are plain code text.
Every element mirrors a design glossary page (`entities/` in the corpus); the page pointer lives in this node's `refs`, never in a doc comment.
Stub modules are allowed, and documented honestly as stubs.

fs.name: Cargo.toml
fs.role: kernel, identity, uuid, serde, serde_json (changelog payloads), async-trait, anyhow, thiserror, derive_more, strum; tokio io-util only to name AsyncRead for the streaming FileStore port; dev-deps proptest, chrono

fs.name: proptest-regressions/
fs.role: committed proptest regressions, at the path of each property file under src/ (workflow/position)

fs.name: src/
fs.role: elements (the commission, the boards) + ports (their seams)

fs.name: tests/
fs.role: fact_contract.rs — the Fact contract (commission-anchored evidence blocks hard deletion)
